   136→  triage:
   137→    needs: [matrix-setup]
   138→    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   139→    timeout-minutes: 45
   140→    env:
   141→      RUN_URL: ${{ needs.matrix-setup.outputs.run_url }}
   142→      E2E_AGENT: ${{ matrix.agent }}
   143→      SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
   144→      SLACK_CHANNEL: ${{ needs.matrix-setup.outputs.slack_channel }}
   145→      SLACK_THREAD_TS: ${{ needs.matrix-setup.outputs.slack_thread_ts }}
   146→    strategy:
   147→      fail-fast: false
   148→      matrix:
   149→        agent: ${{ fromJson(needs.matrix-setup.outputs.agents) }}
   150→    steps:
   151→      - name: Write Slack helper
   152→        if: ${{ env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN != '' && env.SLACK_CHANNEL != '' && env.SLACK_THREAD_TS != '' }}
   153→        shell: bash
   154→        run: |
   155→          set -euo pipefail
   156→
   157→          helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/post-slack-message.sh"
   158→          cat > "$helper" <<'EOF'
   159→          #!/usr/bin/env bash
   160→          set -euo pipefail
   161→
   162→          text="${1:?message is required}"
   163→          payload="$(jq -n \
   164→            --arg channel "$SLACK_CHANNEL" \
   165→            --arg thread_ts "$SLACK_THREAD_TS" \
   166→            --arg text "$text" \
   167→            '{channel: $channel, thread_ts: $thread_ts, text: $text}')"
   168→
   169→          if ! response="$(curl -fsS https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage \
   170→            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SLACK_BOT_TOKEN}" \
   171→            -H 'Content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
   172→            --data "$payload")"; then
   173→            echo "warning: slack notification failed" >&2
   174→            exit 0
   175→          fi
   176→
   177→          if ! jq -e '.ok == true' >/dev/null <<<"$response"; then
   178→            echo "warning: slack notification returned non-ok response" >&2
   179→          fi
   180→          EOF
   181→          chmod +x "$helper"
   182→
   183→      - name: Post triage started
   184→        if: ${{ env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN != '' && env.SLACK_CHANNEL != '' && env.SLACK_THREAD_TS != '' }}
   185→        shell: bash
   186→        run: |
   187→          set -euo pipefail
   188→
   189→          "$RUNNER_TEMP/post-slack-message.sh" "Starting E2E triage for \`$E2E_AGENT\` on <$RUN_URL|this run>."
   190→
   191→      - name: Checkout repository
   192→        uses: actions/checkout@v6
   193→        with:
   194→          fetch-depth: 1
   195→
   196→      - name: Setup mise
   197→        uses: jdx/mise-action@v4
   198→
   199→      - name: Install Claude CLI
   200→        run: |
   201→          curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
   202→          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
   203→
   204→      - name: Run triage
   205→        id: triage
   206→        env:
   207→          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
   208→          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
   209→          TRIAGE_OUTPUT_FILE: ${{ github.workspace }}/e2e-triage-artifacts/${{ matrix.agent }}/triage.log
   210→          TRIAGE_SHA: ${{ needs.matrix-setup.outputs.sha }}
   211→        run: scripts/run-e2e-triage.sh
   212→
   213→      - name: Summarize triage output
   214→        id: summary
   215→        if: always()
   216→        shell: bash
   217→        env:
   218→          TRIAGE_OUTPUT_FILE: ${{ github.workspace }}/e2e-triage-artifacts/${{ matrix.agent }}/triage.log
   219→        run: |
   220→          set -euo pipefail
   221→
   222→          summary=""
   223→          if [ -f "$TRIAGE_OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
   224→            summary="$(
   225→              (grep '^## ' "$TRIAGE_OUTPUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -n 3 | sed 's/^## //' | awk '
   226→                NF {
   227→                  if (out != "") {
   228→                    out = out " | "
   229→                  }
   230→                  out = out $0
   231→                }
   232→                END {
   233→                  print out
   234→                }
   235→              ') || true
   236→            )"
   237→          fi
   238→
   239→          {
   240→            echo 'summary<<EOF'
   241→            printf '%s\n' "$summary"
   242→            echo EOF
   243→          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
   244→
   245→          # Print triage output to job summary
   246→          {
   247→            echo "## E2E Triage: ${E2E_AGENT}"
   248→            echo ""
   249→            if [ -f "$TRIAGE_OUTPUT_FILE" ] && [ -s "$TRIAGE_OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
   250→              sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g; s/\x1b\[[?][0-9]*[a-zA-Z]//g' "$TRIAGE_OUTPUT_FILE"
   251→            else
   252→              echo "No triage output was produced."
   253→              echo ""
   254→              echo "The triage log file was either not created or is empty."
   255→              echo "Check the 'Run triage' step logs for details."
   256→            fi
   257→          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
   258→
   259→      - name: Post triage completion
   260→        if: ${{ always() && (steps.triage.outcome == 'success' || steps.triage.outcome == 'failure') && env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN != '' && env.SLACK_CHANNEL != '' && env.SLACK_THREAD_TS != '' }}
   261→        shell: bash
   262→        env:
   263→          TRIAGE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.triage.outcome }}
   264→          TRIAGE_SUMMARY: ${{ steps.summary.outputs.summary }}
   265→        run: |
   266→          set -euo pipefail
   267→
   268→          if [ "$TRIAGE_OUTCOME" = "success" ]; then
   269→            message="E2E triage complete for \`$E2E_AGENT\`."
   270→          else
   271→            message="E2E triage failed for \`$E2E_AGENT\`."
   272→          fi
   273→          if [ -n "$TRIAGE_SUMMARY" ]; then
   274→            message="$message $TRIAGE_SUMMARY"
   275→          fi
   276→
   277→          "$RUNNER_TEMP/post-slack-message.sh" "$message"
   278→
   279→      - name: Upload triage output
   280→        if: always()
   281→        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
   282→        with:
   283→          name: e2e-triage-${{ matrix.agent }}
   284→          path: e2e-triage-artifacts/
   285→          retention-days: 7
   286→

content.text:
I can see the current state of this branch. You have two uncommitted changes focused on **stripping ANSI escape codes** from the E2E triage output so it renders cleanly in GitHub step summaries:

1. **`scripts/run-e2e-triage.sh`**: Added `--output-format text` and pipes claude output through `sed` to strip ANSI codes before writing to the triage log
2. **`.github/workflows/e2e-triage.yml`**: In the "Summarize triage output" step, replaced `cat` with `sed` to also strip ANSI codes when writing to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The ANSI escape stripping uses two patterns: `\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]` for standard CSI sequences (colors, bold, etc.) and `\x1b\[[?][0-9]*[a-zA-Z]` for private mode sequences (cursor visibility, etc.). Claude CLI outputs these when it thinks it's writing to a terminal — `--output-format text` helps reduce this but `2>&1` captures stderr which may still contain escape codes.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

What would you like to do next? Are you ready to commit these changes, or is there something else you'd like to adjust about the GitHub summary output?
